<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 224.120115. This matches the exact monoisotopic mass of a neutral molecule C₁₆H₁₆O (192 + 16.1252 + 15.9949 = 224.1201). The isotopic pattern (≈17 % M+1) is consistent with ~16 carbons. Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₆H₁₆O.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H16O</final_answer>
